angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 184,361 km at 12.17 pc = 0.2 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 82.1938 +/- 0.0326 mas (same row, RUWE 1.20): 12.17 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.265 +/- 0.012 solar radii from Turner et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Gliese 12 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1703T/abstract): 184,361 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.255 +/- 0.013 solar masses from Turner et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Gliese 12 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1703T/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3328 +/- 78 K from Turner et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Gliese 12 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1703T/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Turner et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Gliese 12 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1703T/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/gliese-12.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.998, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Gliese 12 (pscomppars): spectral type M4 V, from Dholakia et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.531.1276D/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Gliese 12 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.24 dex, from Turner et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1703T/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Gliese 12 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -2.13787, from Kuzuhara et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJ...967L..21K/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Gliese 12 (pscomppars): age 7 Gyr, from Turner et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1703T/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Gliese 12 (pscomppars): rotation period 85 d, from Turner et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1703T/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Gliese 12 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Kuzuhara et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJ...967L..21K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
